decisions.mark: concludes that in a DEFAULT build there is no indirection at all — mbedtls_calloc and mbedtls_free are preprocessor macros expanding directly to calloc and free
decisions.detail: QUOTE: Without `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_MEMORY`, `include/mbedtls/platform.h` (around line 164) does `#define mbedtls_calloc calloc` and `#define mbedtls_free free`. | WHY: The answer states that by default (without MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_MEMORY) mbedtls_calloc and mbedtls_free are macros expanding directly to calloc and free. || QUOTE: Without `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_MEMORY`, `include/mbedtls/platform.h` (around line 164) does `#define mbedtls_calloc calloc` and `#define mbedtls_free free`. | WHY: The answer states that by default (without MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_MEMORY) the two names are preprocessor macros expanding directly to calloc and free.

decisions.mark: identifies that the pointers' defaults FAIL rather than fall back — an uninitialised calloc returns NULL and an uninitialised free does nothing
